verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure for AI agents. Its Drafts API lets an external agent create a draft for human review before sending. Nothing in the evidence shows AgentMail itself generating reply content, or learning or matching the user's voice and tone. The draft-review primitive is a developer building block that someone else's agent fills with text, so it earns no credit for voice-matched AI drafting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
